faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 31 October 2026, and candidates report at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RCC Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Operation Theatre Technician.

faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 31 October 2026 at 10:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.
